result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on which platform your store uses. If you're selling in Canada, there are a few particularly good options.

Here's how I'd compare them.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for online-only businesses.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Accepts major credit cards and digital wallets.
- No monthly processing subscription.
- Canadian domestic online cards: approximately 2.9% + C\$0.30.

Website: [Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Easy checkout and order management.
- Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees charged by Shopify.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognizable and trusted by many shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal accounts.
- Easy to add alongside another processor.
- Fees can be higher depending on checkout method.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Good for businesses selling online and in person.
- Integrates payments and inventory.
- Useful if you attend markets, trade shows or pop-up events.

Website: [Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- Worth considering as your sales volume grows.
- Particularly interesting if processing fees are a major expense.

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com/)

## My recommendation

For a new small online store in Canada\:

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| WooCommerce website | Stripe |
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Online and in-person sales | Square |
| Growing sales volume | Helcim |
| Additional checkout option | PayPal |


I'd generally start with one primary processor and add PayPal as an alternative checkout option.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can help you find the most cost-effective option rather than just the most popular one.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**
